lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What did it smell like? What did it smell like?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Real bad.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. After it burns down, you take the shovel and the rake and bust up the bones, right? Is that what you said?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And then what?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Then we just waited for the fire ta go down.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Mm hum.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: And then we went inta the garage and cleaned up the blood and that.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And how did ya clean the blood up again? Tell me again.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: With her clothes.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. Where is her underwear and her bra? Just tell me that. OK. Where is that? Where is it? Is it at your house? Where is it?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: In some of the stuff that we used to clean up the blood.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Her underwear too and her bra?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Mm huh.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, so you clean up the blood with all of her clothes and what do you do with the clothes then?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: We threw it on the fire.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What next?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Then we waited for that to go down and then

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Then what?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Our mom, my mom got home at like 9:00 o'clock and called Steven.
